entities.summary: John Cornyn III is an American politician and former judge who is the senior United States senator from Texas, a seat he has held since 2002. He is a member of the Republican Party. John Cornyn was a legal figures from Houston (b. 1952-02-02, Houston). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
